weather_report:
As twilight envelopes Boston, the city rests under a softly draping veil of scattered clouds. The air is noticeably brisk, swirling with a whisper of the coming chill, resting at a mild 42 degrees. A gentle southward breeze adds a tender touch, hinting at the warmth promised by tomorrow. The prospects for Sunday unfold with a subtle chance of rain, shyly anticipated in the late afternoon, mingling with the delicateness of cloud cover. This combination invokes a certain intimacy in the air—a suggestion to pause and enjoy moments of quiet reflection.

Tonight and into the morrow, those stepping out might choose layers that reflect the subtle dance of warm and cool. A light jacket, perhaps, to ward off the night’s chill, pairs effortlessly with a cozy scarf—a touch of comfort against the slightly dampening air. With the forecasted cloudiness, the scene outside feels ripe for gentle exploration. One might consider a stroll along the lively streets of the Back Bay, coffee in hand, delighting in the way the city appears to slow, welcoming calm and contemplation before the week begins anew.
